title: National Weather Service API (forecasts, alerts, observations)
agency: National Weather Service, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
questions: active weather warnings in a state
current conditions at an airport station
alerts issued for a county in the last few days

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser and save the JSON under the name shown; for forecasts open the point link first, then the URL in its properties.forecast (or forecastHourly) field, and save that page. Upload the files. Without the links: https://forecast.weather.gov (type the place) shows the same forecast, and https://alerts.weather.gov lists active alerts.

cache.why: Forecasts update hourly and alerts by the minute; every run asks again.

redistribution.why: NWS information is a U.S. government work in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105; https://www.weather.gov/disclaimer); credit the National Weather Service.

retention.note: The API serves current forecasts, active alerts, recent alerts and about the last week of observations only; it is not an archive. Record the retrieval time.

clarify: Forecast, current conditions, or past weather? Forecasts are not historical data; past weather comes from noaa (station observations) instead.
